## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 12-juan late-Míng Chán lamp-record continuation, assembled by the lay editor Shī Pèi and given its final editorial form by the monk Tōngwèn. Title — "Preserved Drafts of the Continuing Lamp" — modestly signals its provisional character: it aims to save useful material rather than to produce a definitive continuation.

**Abstract**

The work is one of several competing late-Míng continuations of the *Wǔdēng huìyuán* ([KR6q0012](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0012)) and *Xù chuándēng lù* ([KR6q0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0016)) traditions. The collaboration of a literatus (Shī Pèi) as principal compiler with a monastic editor (Tōngwèn) is characteristic of the late-Míng lay-monastic Chán ecosystem. Circulation remained limited; the work was preserved in the Jiāxīng canon.
